source: Hello, Could you make a dance game like with a dance studio and a stage where you can get costumes and do tmod and play music and could you name it Aspiring Dance Institution

image_prompt.text: Composed spots around the studio and stage built to look good in screenshots of a dance in progress
An open floor in the dance studio sized for a group of avatars to gather and dance together
The dance institution itself - a studio room and an adjoining stage that players go inside
A raised performance stage with space in front of it for an audience
A place in the studio to get costumes

notes: Dress Up is the only preset in the index with a stage, so it was taken even though its shape is a judging runway and this is a rehearsal studio plus a performance stage.
The prompt reads as entirely indoors. building-interior is the only way the genre files can express an interior at all, and it carries P3 for an outside-to-inside transition that may not exist here.
'do tmod' could not be interpreted and is carried unresolved.
The requested title is Aspiring Dance Institution; the handoff has no field for a game name.

open_questions.ask: What should the institution look like - a bright modern academy, an old theatre, something glitzy?
What does a player actually do - free dance, learn routines, perform for an audience or judges?
Is this one building with two rooms, or a campus you walk across?

coverage_missing.ask: What is the look of the place?
Is there judging, scoring, or an audience, or is it a free hangout?
One building with studio and stage, or separate venues?

answers.ask: What should the institution look like - a bright modern academy, an old theatre, something glitzy?
answers.answer: Make it a bright modern dance academy, with a polished studio and a small performance stage.

answers.ask: What does a player actually do - free dance, learn routines, perform for an audience or judges?
answers.answer: Players can free dance in the studio and perform on the stage; no judges or routine-learning system is required.
“Tmod” means a dance moderation/admin tool for managing dances and music.

answers.ask: Is this one building with two rooms, or a campus you walk across?
answers.answer: Keep it as one building with a dance studio and a stage area, including a costume section.
